title: KHR_character_expression_texture_transform KHR_character_expression Expression Entry Extension
description: Classifies listed expression-animation channels as KHR_texture_transform property channels.

channels.description: Nonempty array of unique indices classifying KHR_texture_transform property channels. A consumer that supports this extension produces response records for the listed channels when the expression entry's effective driver is positive, subject to the base extension's target-support rules; a consumer that does not support it produces none for them. Every channel of the selected animation still contributes to the base expression duration.

items.description: Index of a classified channel in the expression entry's selected animation.
items.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `channels` array of the animation selected by the containing expression entry's `animation` property. The channel MUST use KHR_animation_pointer to target offset, scale, or rotation on an actually authored KHR_texture_transform object.
